paragraphs: 3 Day Cabinet Pros and More does kitchen remodeling in Machesney Park, IL, and across the Stateline area with one focus: quality cabinets installed quickly. Most cabinet installs take one to two days, and most projects go from first visit to finished kitchen in two to three weeks.

Founder Liam McCormack believes a long timeline is a sign of a problem, not a sign of care. So every job is planned before work starts, with a detailed scope, a clear budget breakdown and your door, finish and hardware choices locked in. The crew installing your cabinets works for Liam, and has for an average of five-plus years.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Machesney Park, IL: cabinets, refacing and countertops

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: New cabinets from three lines, Essential, Signature and Luxury, plus countertops, sinks and backsplashes, all planned with a detailed design and cost breakdown before a start date is set. The firm has completed hundreds of kitchen remodels and keeps the core installation work in-house.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with gray shaker cabinets, stainless gas range, tan vertical tile backsplash and white counters

items.name: Cabinet Refacing
items.blurb: If your cabinet boxes are solid, refacing gives you new doors, drawer fronts, hardware and veneers without tearing everything out. It looks like a full replacement for a fraction of the $30,000 to $50,000 a tear-out can cost, and Liam will tell you honestly which option fits.

image.alt: Refaced kitchen cabinets in light gray shaker style with navy arabesque tile backsplash and stainless appliances

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Precise templating comes first, then fabrication and installation by a countertop partner the team has worked with for more than two years. 3 Day Cabinet Pros coordinates every trade and owns the result, so there is no finger-pointing between the contractor and the fabricator.

image.alt: Kitchen with cream shaker cabinets, granite countertops, white subway tile and stainless gas range

items.title: Your installers are employees
items.text: The people who install your cabinets work for 3 Day Cabinet Pros full time and have been with the company an average of five-plus years. No crew pulled from a list.

items.title: Known partners for specialty trades
items.text: Plumbing, electrical and countertops go to licensed specialists who have worked alongside the team for at least two years, so there are no strangers in your home.

items.title: What you approve is what you get
items.text: Doors, drawer fronts, hardware and finish are chosen before your start date is scheduled. No substitutions, and you know the full price before work begins.

items.title: Problems handled out loud
items.text: When something comes up on a job, Liam shares the facts, skips the blame and works out a plan with you. Fixing it is always the company's responsibility.

about.h2: Liam McCormack learned the trade by doing it
about.text: Liam McCormack grew up in a family of entrepreneurs and was fixing plumbing and hanging entry doors at age 12. He left college after a year, went back to the trades and built 3 Day Cabinet Pros and More from the relationships he made with clients and crews. Early on, a rushed sink hookup by a crew member led to a trap that leaked across the floor. The damage was small but the lesson stuck: slow down to do it right, especially when it is not easy. Today Liam wants every client to feel they could invite him over for dinner.

process.h2: Four steps from consultation to a kitchen you love

steps.title: Free in-home design consultation
steps.text: The team comes to you, measures your space, listens to your plans and walks you through all three cabinet collections with upfront pricing.

steps.title: Choose your cabinets and confirm the design
steps.text: You get a custom design and detailed quote, choose style, finish and features, and the team handles ordering and scheduling once you approve.

steps.title: Professional installation
steps.text: The in-house crew arrives on time and treats your home with respect. Most cabinet projects take just one to two days to install.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You check every door and drawer together. The job is not done until you are completely satisfied with the result.

service_area.h2: Serving the Stateline area of Illinois and Wisconsin
service_area.text: The shop is on Turret Drive in Machesney Park, and the crew works across the Stateline area on both sides of the border. In Illinois that means Machesney Park, Loves Park, Rockford, Roscoe, Rockton, South Beloit and Belvidere. In Wisconsin the team covers Beloit, Janesville, Clinton and Milton. The company is licensed and insured to work in both states, and the crew travels to you for every consultation.

items.q: How fast can my kitchen be done?
items.a: Most projects go from first consultation to finished kitchen in two to three weeks, and most kitchen cabinet installs take one to two days on site. The speed comes from planning: your design, materials and schedule are confirmed before the crew arrives, so the installers can work without waiting on decisions or deliveries.

items.q: Should I reface or replace my cabinets?
items.a: If your cabinet boxes are solid and the layout works, refacing gives you new doors, drawer fronts, hardware and veneers for far less than a $30,000 to $50,000 tear-out. If a full remodel makes more sense, Liam will say so at the consultation, even when refacing would be the cheaper answer for you.

items.q: What cabinet lines do you offer?
items.a: There are three. The Essential Collection offers lasting quality at an accessible price. The Signature Collection is the most popular, with elevated style and premium finishes. The Luxury Collection uses the finest materials, finishes and hardware available. If you are unsure which fits, the team will help you decide during the free consultation.
